```lean
theorem lg_target {b x : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => Real.exp (-(b * x))) (Set.Ioc 0 x) MeasureTheory.volume := by
  refine' MeasureTheory.integrableOn_comp (Real.exp ∘ (- (b *))) (Set.Ioc 0 x) _
  · exact hb
  · refine' MeasureTheory.integrableOn_exp (Set.Ioc 0 x) _
    · exact hb
    · exact MeasureTheory.volume
```
